scope: Six fixed primary 2025 municipal station crops and cycle1 candidate row; source labels are station roles, not exact Pand joins. No heldout inspection.
method: Direct inspection of all six cycle2 source-row renders, cornice-upper/neck-middle/bell-lower block renders and neck-middle/bell-lower opposite obliques against six source photos already inspected in cycle1. CPU ray-to-native-footprint projection used only for approximate rendered-strip ownership, not source-photo identity registration.
decision: rejected-cycle2: critical crown/roof-continuity and raised-entry failures remain; shared visible-return admission gap interrupts row rhythm

worstView.reason: Large thin triangular roof projection still spans sky at left, second projection at right; shaped cap is low/shallow and no paired oculi read. Prominent ordinary gray shop return with black scalloped awning remains.

criteria.reason: Admitted dark fronts now visibly use broad separate two/three-column groups instead of dense skinny panes. Ground panes are taller and upper/attic panes shorten; late-year-neck is visibly three-column rather than six skinny columns. Surrounds remain pale with restrained dark bars. Ordinary protruding orange/green-framed context still has skinny historic window grammar, so this is not whole-block acceptance.
criteria.remainingLimit: Window subdivision is highly uniform and upper surrounds rather thin, but these do not outweigh the useful group-spacing improvement; exact individual pane counts remain secondary.

criteria.reason: Cycle2 adds pale cornice strips and low framed crown caps, but neck-middle still reads as wall-height steps plus shallow roof caps rather than narrowed rising neck fronts. No visibly paired oculi in six reviewed stations. Late-year-neck center remains bare wall top. Cornice-upper retains center sky slit under the floating beam. Bell-lower and lower-unmatched retain enormous thin sky triangles; source-backed silhouette mixture is not achieved.
criteria.nextImprovement: Make crown-owned wall/roof geometry actually visible, close roof/wall gaps and remove detached plates; add a clearly readable bounded neck/bell/cornice distribution with paired oculi integrated inside at least one compatible bell family.

criteria.reason: Dark main fronts/pale frames and bounded pale exception remain useful. Repeated orange/green generic protruding returns between them interrupt dark row composition, disproportionately affecting block/oblique views. CPU projection locates several returns on the same genuine buildings already admitted to the canal cohort, so this is a visible exposed-edge treatment gap rather than unrelated distant context. Exact return dimensions/photographed corner matching remain secondary.
criteria.nextImprovement: Review exposed front-run admission and priority so ordinary facade treatments do not dominate the observed row; preserve native geometry and avoid building-ID appearance overrides.

criteria.reason: Ground treatment is unchanged from cycle1: tall glazing improves opening hierarchy, but admitted main fronts have repeated glass-only ground openings at pavement, without readable side entry/raised base/connected stairs and rails. Ordinary returns instead retain stock green fanlight doors or generic broad shop awning. This is still a critical assembly failure; proposed cycle3 fixes are not credited to this frozen cycle2.
criteria.nextImprovement: Add connected side-entry/tall-ground-pane assemblies with meaningful raised bases and stairs/rails, plus bounded commercial variants. Do not make every tall ground opening the same glass-only module.

criteria.reason: No repeating open residential balcony stack dominates the admitted primary dark fronts. However the broad black scalloped shop awning/fascia on the protruding gray front and disconnected black cross-like facade hardware are prominent in bell-lower/lower-unmatched context; the awning conflicts with the restrained source canopy/stoop grammar. Detached roof pieces independently violate the no-gap/slab allowance.
criteria.nextImprovement: Keep low balcony frequency and constrain optional generic ground extras inside observed frontage cohorts; resolve generic shop override ownership before treating offline primary pass as actual-game success.

nextAction: Cycle3 must make native-height neck/bell/cornice fronts visibly rise from their parent walls, remove thin sky triangles and demonstrate paired oculi; add connected raised side entrances and improve cohort treatment of visible street-side returns. Re-review all six sources plus broad blocks/obliques before any heldout or production acceptance.
boundaries: Only six fixed primary source crops visually inspected; not exhaustive twenty-frontage coverage.
No game-scene or performance evidence reviewed; offline screenshots cannot establish scoped production completion.
The prior 17m Bethanien source class is separate and supplies no acceptance for this canal row.

visibleReturnOwnership.method: Approximate first positive CPU ray/footprint wall intersection at saved source-row pixel, using report matrixWorld/vfov/viewport and native stage input. Hit requires native-height vertical interval. No browser or code modifications.

gray narrow return and generic shop

visibleReturnOwnership.finding: All three hit identities already appear in surveyed canal profile frontages, but hit wall edges differ from the surveyed assigned main-front segments. Consistent visible-return cohort treatment is a meaningful shared rhythm improvement; blanket whole-building facade overriding may incorrectly alter unrelated rear edges.
